QuestInfo.2: You have completed your assignment for the week. Talk to #p2230000# at #m241000220# again next week to receive a new weekly quest.

no.0: Oh, I understand. You should rest. You've been working real hard, after all! If you change your mind, I'll be here... always...

1.0: You really beat them all? Astonishing! Amazing! I'm so impressed, I want you to have this Anti-Magic Stone I promised to give you!

yes.0: There's absolutely nothing left for you to do today.
